blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.
I'll wait for you to get back.
I don't want to wait that long.
blocks.note: لا أريد أن أنتظر هذا أطول.

blocks.text: He doesn't want to wait for you.
Wait. I want to tell you something.
I told him not to wait for you anymore.
blocks.note: قلت له أن يتوقّف عن انتظارك.

blocks.text: Tom and Mary will wait as long as they have to.
blocks.note: توم و ماري سَينتضران طالَما عَلَيهما ذَلِكَ

blocks.text: I had nothing else to do.
blocks.note: لم يكن لديّ أيّ شيء آخر أقوم به.

sentences.t: Who else saw you?
What else do you want?
What else did they say?
Please ask someone else.
You know what else, Tom?
I had nothing else to do.
sentences.ar: لم يكن لديّ أيّ شيء آخر أقوم به.

sentences.t: What else do you have to do?
sentences.ar: ما الأمر الآخر الذي يجب عليك ان تفعله؟

sentences.t: He didn't say anything else.
Would you like anything else?
I'm in love with someone else.
Ziri had no one else with him.
Please have someone else do it.
sentences.ar: اجعل أحداً آخر يقوم بذلك إذا سمحت.

sentences.t: He's in love with someone else.
Ziri didn't find anything else.
sentences.ar: لم يجد زيري أي شيء آخر.

sentences.t: She doesn't want anyone else to know.
sentences.ar: لا تريد أن يعلم أحد بالأمر.

sentences.t: Tom said he wanted something else to eat.
sentences.ar: قال توم بأنه يريد شيئا آخر يأكله.

sentences.t: Is there anyone else you want to talk to?
sentences.ar: هل هناك أي شخص آخر تريد التحدث إليه؟

sentences.t: Is there anything else you want to tell me?
sentences.ar: هل يوجد أي شيء أخر تريد أن تُخبرني به؟

sentences.t: I want to talk to you about something else.
sentences.ar: أريد التحدث اليك عن شيء آخر.

sentences.t: I can only wonder if this is the same for everyone else.
sentences.ar: أتساءل فقط إن كان الأمر مشابهًا بالنسبة للآخرين.

sentences.t: Do you remember?
We remember you.
I don't remember.
Sami can remember.
